fact: The article states that Circular 16 of 2022 generalised the Mobile ID authentication certificate as unified digital identity for access to services, and that e-Houwiya lets citizens authenticate online, sign administrative documents, access government portals and transact with banks and insurers; ANCE-approved trust service providers deliver DigiGo and mobile signing.
title: La signature numérique en Tunisie : Cadre juridique, acteurs et enjeux contemporains
